title: Analyze baseline
tagline: Measure an existing side profile -- camber height, rocker contact points and lengths, tip heights -- to compare a ski with its design targets.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Generate baseline builds a profile from targets; Analyze baseline goes the other way. Give it any baseline -- scanned, drawn, or generated -- and it reports the same quantities, and can draw them as a sketch.
useWhen: Check a scanned or supplied ski against targets
slides.caption: The quantities it reports: minima, camber, FRCP / ARCP, rocker lengths, tip heights.

slides.title: The dialog
params: Read-only: FB / AB minimum, max camber point, camber height, FRCP, FRCPL, FRCP tangent, FCPH, ARCP, ARCPL, ARCP tangent, ACPH.
Chords, tangent lines and normals on the XZ plane.
Button (the values are also refreshed on every dialog change).

points.head: Camber
points.body: Largest perpendicular distance from the line between the two low points.

points.head: FRCP / ARCP
points.body: The lowest inflection in each half; FRCPL = its distance from FCP.

points.head: FCPH / ACPH
points.body: The tip's perpendicular distance to the tangent at FRCP / ARCP.

items.head: Dialog only
items.body: Values are computed while editing and do not follow later geometry changes.

items.head: No inflection
items.body: A half with no inflection leaves its fields empty.

items.head: Name
items.body: The feature is spelled 'Analze baseline' in Onshape.

rows: EI and Cross Section, Estimate Stiffness, Estimate Deflection, Generate / Analyze baseline, Update profile
